title: Databasise derived run trace record
description: The Databasise derived run trace schema: docs/system-model/rig-trace.schema.json (frozen, unedited) plus the declared amendments in databasise/evidence/RIG-TRACE-DEVIATIONS.md, one row per amendment. A divergence from the frozen shape is recorded there, never resolved silently in this file alone.

TokenAccounting.description: D-14 — prompt/completion/cached-read tokens and call count recorded separately per node, never as one aggregate. counted_by is CONTRACT.md §4's own mandatory field, reused verbatim.

counted_by.description: Tokenizer id + revision, per CONTRACT.md §4's token-accounting rule.

NodeTrace.description: One per-node trace record, per RIG.md §TR.1's per-node field list.

instance_hash.description: The (name@version, config_hash, resolved_dependency_ids) identity tuple, per CONTRACT.md §1.

effective_depth.description: Minimum over transitive deps, computed never declared, per CONTRACT.md §3's blast-radius rule.

tier.description: CONTRACT.md §4's evidence-item tier, machine-stamped from what arrived at the boundary. Null where no evidence-tier machinery measured it.

feed_tier.description: The tier this node's output feeds forward as, a pooling-key member alongside tier per CONTRACT.md §4. Null where no evidence-tier machinery measured it.

cache_hit.description: Per CONTRACT.md §5's D7 repair — arm execution order and per-node cache hit/miss MUST be stamped on the run record. Null where the part reported none.

guards_fired.description: Per CONTRACT.md §19.8 — which declared data guards fired on this node this run.

realised_budget_share.description: Per CONTRACT.md §9's merge-side apportionment repair (D4) — this node's realised share of the budget it was apportioned.

cross_process_failure_cause.description: Per CONTRACT.md §3 — cross-process invocations MUST record the placement of both endpoints and the failure cause; null where no cross-process failure occurred at this node.

resumable.description: Per CONTEXT.md D-13 — true only where this node's completed execution carries a verified-determinism stamp and no store mutation occurred; the run-lifecycle mechanics that set this flag are RIG-07's (plan 05-02), named here and not designed here.

status.description: What became of this node in the run: it completed, it failed, it was cancelled with its batch, or it was never scheduled.

execution_mode.description: CONTRACT.md §3's derived placement, stamped whether or not the placement was hosted.

spent.description: Metered token spend at this node's boundary; null where the node never completed.

allowance.description: The token allowance this node was handed; null where the node was never handed one.

status.description: Optional project-convention marker (matches every other file in wirings/): illustrative-only-not-a-registered-wiring. Not a trace field RIG-02 itself requires.

status_note.description: Optional project-convention prose paired with status. Not a trace field RIG-02 itself requires.

arm_execution_order.description: Per CONTRACT.md §5's D7 repair — this arm's position in the run's actual execution order, so a run-order dependency on cache state is diagnosable from the trace alone.

executor_version.description: The fifth of CONTRACT.md §10's five versioned instruments.

concurrency_setting.description: Per CONTRACT.md §4 — a gate-admission condition and a member of the A/A-null keying rule.

allOf.description: §TR.3's required-together rule: a truthy partial MUST carry a real stop_reason and degradation_reason, never leave either null.
§TR.3's required-together rule, degraded side: a truthy degraded MUST carry a real stop_reason and degradation_reason.
